title: A missing theorem on dual spaces
annotation: The issue is that an error in Proposition 2.3 undermines the validity of Lemmas 3 and 4, and Theorem 4.1 depends on results from Proposition 2.3; therefore, Lemmas 3 and 4 are only valid if the conclusions of Proposition 2.3 hold for the map q used in Theorem 4.1.

title: A New Radio to Overcome Critical Link Budgets
annotation: The error is that the beamforming gain for N antennas is incorrectly calculated as N, when it should actually be N^2, since coherent beamforming results in the received power increasing by the square of the number of antennas.

title: A Simple, Nearly-Optimal Algorithm for Differentially Private All-Pairs Shortest Distances
annotation: The error is the incorrect assumption in Sections 3 and 4 that the topology of the shortest path trees is public, which may not be true; additionally, in Section 3, Lemma 2.4 is applied inappropriately under this false assumption.

title: Every Polish group has a non-trivial topological group automorphism
annotation: The error is that extending a non-trivial automorphism of L by fixing elements of a maximal independent subset Y of U can inadvertently redefine the automorphism on elements of L that are generated by Y, making the extension invalid.

title: Nevanlinna Theory on Geodesic Balls of Complete K√§hler Manifolds

title: Algebraic description of complex conjugation on cohomology of a smooth projective hypersurface
annotation: The statement and proof of Theorem 2.3 is not correct. What was described in the paper is an order 2 operation which swaps the Hodge components, which gives the complex conjugation only when the Hodge component has dimensions 1. But our description does not give the complex conjugation in the general case where the Hodge component has a bigger dimension

title: On the Existence of an Extremal Function for the Delsarte Extremal Problem

annotation: The error is that Jacobian algebras do not generally have the Ext-symmetry required for the GLS multiplication formula, and generalized preprojective algebras are not always Jacobian because the nilpotency relations for loops are not derived from the potential.

title: Fields of definition of dynamical systems on $\mathbb{P}^{1}$. Improvements on a result of Silverman
